summary: Wishlist list treats each element of every `wishlists` array in WishlistIndexPageQuery as one wishlist, decodes Relay global ids to numeric ids, and counts saved items from productIds.
reason: A generic key search for `wishlists`/`wishlist` matched the WishlistIndexPage container instead of the wishlists inside it, so `airbnb_wishlist list` (and both wishlist sync paths) returned a single entry with no id or count and only the first list's name.
validated_outcome: Against a live account with several wishlists, `airbnb_wishlist list` returns one row per wishlist with numeric ids and item counts that match airbnb.com; unit tests cover a trimmed real response shape and a null `wishlists` array.
